draw_policy.default: frozen-instance-by-default: scripts/build_images.sh reads the Judge-only Infrathon asset judge/final_cases.json (INFRATHON_ASSETS_ROOT) unless FINAL_CASES_PATH names another instance; every host that builds from this tree scores the same 254 cases
draw_policy.per_call_seeds: every warm-up, untimed and measured call draws its page layout and data from SHA-256(case seed, role, trial) truncated to 63 bits; untimed calls shorten each request by up to 20% while keeping its shared blocks
draw_policy.privacy: hidden lengths, shared blocks, request schedules, head configurations and seeds are Judge-only; this manifest lists only opaque case IDs and families
draw_policy.redraw: a new plan is a NEW suite identity: frozen_instance must be re-recorded and no earlier score is comparable to it

edge_suite.privacy: Judge-only path judge/private/, staged mode 0600 into the root-only Judge build context with the final holdout, proven absent from every Work build context by scripts/validate_layout.py
edge_suite.semantics: untimed zero-weight hard gates over the whole support domain (any 1 <= B <= 256, any 1 <= S_q <= 16, h_q <= 128 with any group size, page sizes 1-256, page tables up to 4x wider than needed, page pools larger than B x width with repeated page ids, hidden cache slots and unused pages holding NaN or Inf): each native case is called twice on one fresh guarded input set (output re-poisoned between calls); complete writes, the kvcache tolerance rule and the normalized-L2 backstop, 1 MiB guard bands with soft-landing metadata fills and byte-exact inputs after every call; the sanitize subset also runs once under compute-sanitizer memcheck with the caching allocator disabled, before any native call, and its sanitizer-only case (a K/V pool above 2**31 elements) runs only there

frozen_instance.provenance: frozen plan judge/source/paged-gqa-plan-v2.json (Judge-only asset; v4.2: 1114 cases, Mooncake conversation and tool-agent traces, 80 sequences, PagedAttention sharing workloads, FA3 outlier values; v4.3 appended two public cases), converted with scripts/generate_final_manifest.py

selection_semantics: the sanitizer subset of the private edge cases (12 cases, one of them sanitizer-only) runs first under compute-sanitizer memcheck, so an out-of-bounds kernel is stopped before any native call; then the 167 native edge cases run and must all pass; then the 1114 scored cases run, each also a correctness and memory-safety gate; each family's cases are geometrically averaged and the score is the geometric mean of the decode, spec, long and stream family scores; the terminal score is a fresh evaluation of the final snapshot, not an average of earlier feedback
timeout_semantics: suite gates and orchestration ceilings qualify the selected execution profile; they do not identify a GPU model

families.decode: one decode step of a busy server, S_q = 1: per-request cache lengths, batch composition and shared-prefix blocks from a simulated server replaying a request trace with a per-rank KV budget from the model configuration ; plus the parallel-sampling (n = 2, 4, 6), beam-search (width 2, 4, 6) and shared few-shot prompt (80 and 341 tokens) workloads of the PagedAttention paper, with page-granular sharing
families.long: contexts up to each model's maximum position (up to 1,048,576): single requests, one long request inside a busy batch, and the four configurations of the split-KV decode benchmark the semantics come from
families.spec: 2-16 query tokens per request at small batch sizes, lengths from the same simulation at low load
families.stream: 80 sequences of 512 consecutive decode steps of one server (ten of them speculative, S_q 2-5): requests join and leave between steps, pages are reserved on arrival and returned on departure through a fragmented free list, the table width and pool stay fixed; 16 untimed calls on nearby shapes, then every step timed with compilation counted; at most 120 s of timed calls per sequence

workload.head_configurations: public models split across tensor-parallel ranks; disjoint from the public suite
workload.layout: physical pages come from a random permutation of a pool larger than the call needs; every distinct shared 512-token block owns one set of pages read by every request that lists it; table entries past a request's last page are arbitrary valid ids; a quarter of the decode cases hold NaN in hidden slots
workload.plan: the plan (model configurations, request traces, server simulation) is kept outside the repository; scripts/generate_final_manifest.py converts and checks it
workload.values: a quarter of the single calls draw Q, K and V from N(0,1) + N(0,100) * Bernoulli(0.001), the outlier distribution of the FlashAttention-3 numerics study
